title: assert! not debug_assert! in blob_path is correct defence-in-depth
description: Upgrading debug_assert! to assert! in blob_path means path-traversal panics in release if a future caller bypasses validate_blob_id. Given the security invariant (no '/' or '..' in id → base_dir.join(id) cannot escape base_dir), having this fire in production on programming mistakes is strictly better than silently serving wrong paths. The companion change to blob_exists (early return false on invalid id rather than calling blob_path) correctly avoids the assert triggering on attacker-controlled input. A contributor might suggest reverting to debug_assert for performance — the assert is a single O(n≤128) pure function call on an infrequently called path and the security benefit is clear.
